Name: Current Events Dialogue
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple mod that makes use of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9550]Dialogue Trees[/url] framework to let you converse about various topics of conversation.

Currently, this is a WIP, just to showcase the framework mod for now.

It has dialogue for the following characters:

[list]
[*]Abigail
[/list]
Topics you can converse about include:

[list]
[*]Climate Change
[*]Politics
[*]Stardew Valley
[*]Romance
[/list]

To talk to Abigail about any of these topics, first exhaust any dialogue options with her, then either ask her about one of them by holding Left Alt and left clicking on her, or have her ask you about one of them by holding down Left Alt and right clicking on her.


This mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Dialogue Trees.

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
